note: Bounded areas candidate discovery can survey. A search area must lie inside the loaded road-network extract and the loaded habitat extracts; discovery reports PARTIAL coverage rather than guessing when it does not. This is a pilot window, not national coverage.

searchAreas.name: Oregon pilot area
searchAreas.note: The same bounded window the road, wetland, hydrography, and ecoregion extracts were built for: about 25 km by 18 km west of Portland, Oregon, in Washington and Multnomah counties.

searchAreas.name: Portland west region (partitioned)
searchAreas.note: A real larger Oregon test area within the partitioned TIGER, NWI and NHD coverage; local data files are served through the same static manifest contract as future R2 objects.

searchAreas.name: Regional benchmark: 10-mile radius
searchAreas.note: Committed benchmark scenario on a fixed centre, so 10-, 25- and 50-mile searches differ only in radius. The bounding box selects cells; the disk decides which corridors are inside the search.

searchAreas.name: Regional benchmark: 25-mile radius
searchAreas.note: Committed benchmark scenario: one 25-mile radius disk on the same fixed centre as the 10- and 50-mile cases.

searchAreas.name: Regional benchmark: 50-mile radius
searchAreas.note: Committed benchmark scenario: one 50-mile radius disk on the same fixed centre, inside the published Greater Portland region with room for its 1 km habitat halo and cross-cell road continuity.
